==== src/VerifySample.Tests/ModuleInitializer.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ReadableExpressions&min=ReadableExpressions&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;

// Everything here runs once, when the test assembly loads, before any test.
public static class ModuleInitializer
{
    [ModuleInitializer]
    public static void Initialize()
    {
        // Initializes every Verify.* plugin the project references and has not initialized above.
        // Explicit calls come first so their parameters apply: a plugin can only be initialized once.
        VerifierSettings.InitializePlugins();
    }
}

==== src/VerifySample.Tests/Plugins/ReadableExpressionsTests.cs

// Generated by the Verify wizard: https://verifytests.github.io/Wizard/new?step=output&os=Windows&ide=Rider&cli=Cli&tf=XunitV3&ci=GitHubActions&ext=ReadableExpressions&min=ReadableExpressions&sponsor=Exempt&exempt=OpenSource&until=2027-09
// Delete whatever is not needed.
using System.Linq.Expressions;

// Verify.ReadableExpressions: Renders LINQ expression trees as readable C# source, instead of the default ToString() of the tree.
// https://github.com/VerifyTests/Verify.ReadableExpressions
// Note: The converter is inserted at index 0, so it wins over any other converter that handles
// Expression, including one an ORM plugin registers.
// Note: With Verify.EntityFramework selected, expression trees inside EF snapshots therefore
// render as C#.
// Note: VerifyReadableExpressions exposes only Initialize(): no settings methods, no formatting
// options.
// Note: Verify.ReadableExpressions is pre 1.0 (0.1.0).
public class ReadableExpressionsTests
{
    // An expression tree's own ToString() is barely readable once it nests. This writes the C#
    // the tree represents, so a change to a query shows up as a change in source.
    [Fact]
    public Task QueryExpression()
    {
        Expression<Func<IEnumerable<int>, IEnumerable<int>>> expression =
            numbers => numbers
                .Where(number => number > 10)
                .Select(number => number * 2);
        return Verify(expression);
    }
}
